audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart sides were all 'Skill' in the full layer while the content layer win[] read Karma/Karma/Karma/Brand/Brand/Brand/Brand — the two layers rendered different answers to 'who wins Level 1'.
audit.why: Karma's Inner Flame is 950 range vs Brand's 900 Pillar of Flame, Mantra is free at level 1 with no skill point, and Focused Resolve is a flat 12s root at 675. Brand has no stun until E+Q at level 3 and no ult until 6. Packet levelChart and content win[] agree with the kit; only phases[].side was stale.
audit.corrected: phases[0..2].side = Karma, phases[3..6].side = Brand, matching win[] and the packet chart; whys rewritten for the first three rows to match the new verdict.

audit.why: Spikes are level 3 (E-Q stun package), level 6 (Pyroclasm, 100s at rank 1), Liandry's first item, and late AoE. Karma's spike is Mantra availability from level 1 and its 40/38/36/34s cooldown reduced further by Gathering Fire.
audit.corrected: Kept the four spikes; grounded spikes[2] in Mantra Focused Resolve's heal and the Oblivion Orb answer.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content described 'her W speed shield' and 'Tether's speed boost' — Focused Resolve (W) is the root tether; Inspire (E) is the shield plus move speed. Mantra Focused Resolve's self-heal was never mentioned despite the anti-heal flag.
audit.why: Riot's text: W tethers, damages, reveals and roots; Mantra W heals Karma and extends the root. E shields and grants move speed. Brand's Sear only stuns targets already ablaze, so Conflagration (625, point-and-click) must land first.
audit.corrected: Corrected the W/E confusion, stated the E-then-Q stun requirement, and added the Grievous Wounds timing against Mantra Focused Resolve.

audit.why: Focused Resolve is 12s at every rank; Mantra is 40/38/36/34s; Sear is 8/7.5/7/6.5/6s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seven fields called Karma 'he/his/him'; dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d were verbatim tradeGood/tradeBad pastes under unrelated titles.
audit.why: Karma is she/her per champ-gender.js; the bullets promised one thing and explained another.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed and both bullets rewritten to match their titles.
